title: Commit Boundary Request
description: Request schema for invoking AGCP Commit Boundary processing. Commit Boundary processing verifies that authoritative Execution Authorization, Canonical State, Authority Lineage, Governance Context, tenant/domain constraints, and governance configuration remain valid immediately before the governed Action may become operationally real.

execution_authorization_ref.description: Identifier of the authoritative Execution Authorization that must be bound to the Action at Commit Boundary processing.

governance_decision_ref.description: Reference to the Governance Decision Result that formed the basis for Execution Authorization.

execution_context.description: Execution context to be validated against the authorized Governance Context and Action Representation before commit. This context SHALL NOT alter the qualified Action Representation.

action_representation_hash.description: Optional integrity hash of the qualified Action Representation used to detect mutation before Commit Boundary processing.

metadata.description: Implementation-defined request metadata that SHALL NOT alter normative commit semantics.
